title: Photos of Tim Taylor at Bledsoe children's football games

tellings.quote: didn't Isn't there photos of Tim Taylor at like football games of of Chris Bledso's children or something like that?

plain: There are supposed to be photos of a man named Tim Taylor at football games played by the children of a man named Chris Bledsoe, which would put the two men closer together than one might expect. A researcher who goes by the online name UAPGerb raises this with Michels as a half-remembered question ("Isn't there photos of Tim Taylor at like football games of Chris Bledsoe's children or something like that?"), without naming where the photos come from.
